en: Color postcard showing a stone ruin of a 16th‑century structure surrounded by lush trees. In the foreground there is a circular orange fountain decorated with reliefs of dancing figures and water jets spraying inward and outward. The back side contains multilingual captions identifying the site as the ruins of Tettye in Pécs, Hungary, plus publisher and price information.
